Implementation Plan

Planning ref context:
- `git rev-parse HEAD`: `0098891da151fd1927030faea172921abef272ae`

- Integration metadata branch: `orchestrator/project-1479`
- Mismatch: `false` (planning can proceed)

Clarification mapping:
- No `Q<ID>` clarifications were asked in this issue.
- `/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]` is interpreted as “proceed with the issue-defined scope as-is.”

Conflicts detected:
- `review_autofix.yml` currently has an explicit failure-path comment to avoid sourcing `label_helpers.sh` if support scripts were not fetched, but this issue requires shared helper usage in that same path. Plan: use shared helper when available, with fail-open fallback behavior to preserve runtime safety.
- Requested regression tests (`test_label_helpers_phase_transition_contract.py`, `test_issue_pr_status_payload_fallback_contract.py`) do not currently exist.

Implementation plan:

1. Files likely to change
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh`
- `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml`
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`
- `tests/test_label_helpers_phase_transition_contract.py` (new)
- `tests/test_issue_pr_status_payload_fallback_contract.py` (new)
- One review-autofix contract test file (new or update existing, likely new for isolation)
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (to run new tests)

2. Functions/modules to implement
- Add `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` in `scripts/label_helpers.sh` with signature like `set_issue_phase_label_resilient <issue_number> <target_label> [repo]`.
- Preserve `ensure_label_exists` semantics unchanged.
- In `issue_pr_status.yml` replace inline `_AI_PHASE_LABELS` GET/PUT/POST mutation loop with calls to `set_issue_phase_label_resilient`.
- In `review_autofix.yml` replace the three duplicated inline phase-transition blocks with `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` calls in:
  - `Mark linked issues ready to merge`
  - `Mark linked issues review-blocked (autofix exhaustion)`
  - `Mark linked issues review-blocked (workflow failure)`

3. Data structures affected
- Shared phase-label set (JSON/list inside `label_helpers.sh`) used for exclusivity filtering.
- Existing workflow vars reused for fallback parsing:
  - `issue_pr_status.yml`: event payload `PR_TITLE`/`PR_BODY` added to env and consumed before GH pull fetch.
  - `review_autofix.yml`: `PR_META_FILE` title/body consumed before GH pull fetch fallback.
- Existing `LINKED_ISSUES_JSON` remains first source in review_autofix.

4. API/interface changes
- New shared shell helper API: `set_issue_phase_label_resilient`.
- No breaking renames/removals of existing labels/env vars/steps.
- API hygiene change: fallback parsing order becomes:
  - linked issues GraphQL/cache → local payload/meta text (`PR_TITLE`/`PR_BODY` or `PR_META_FILE`) → `gh api repos/.../pulls/...` only if local text is empty.
- No new redundant `gh api` calls; expected reduction in fallback pull fetches.

5. Potential risks/edge cases
- Failure-path helper availability in `review_autofix.yml` when support scripts are absent; must stay fail-open and not block labeling.
- Regex issue extraction can over/under-match unusual PR text; keep existing pattern behavior to avoid regressions.
- Label mutation API failures (GET/PUT/POST) and 404-like responses must not fail the workflow; warn and continue.
- Ensure exclusivity removes only intended phase labels (avoid accidental removal of non-phase labels).

6. Testing considerations
- `tests/test_label_helpers_phase_transition_contract.py`:
  - assert helper exists and uses resilient GET/PUT + POST fallback flow;
  - assert no legacy fragile remove-label pattern is introduced;
  - assert `ensure_label_exists` contract remains intact.
- `tests/test_issue_pr_status_payload_fallback_contract.py`:
  - assert payload-first fallback (`PR_TITLE`/`PR_BODY`) is present;
  - assert GH pull fetch is only conditional fallback;
  - assert workflow calls `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` and no inline `_AI_PHASE_LABELS` block remains there.
- Review-autofix contract test (new or updated):
  - assert all 3 targeted steps call `set_issue_phase_label_resilient`;
  - assert targeted steps no longer define inline `_AI_PHASE_LABELS` mutation blocks;
  - assert `PR_META_FILE` is used before fallback pull fetch.
- Update `ci.yml` to execute the new tests explicitly in the existing Python test section.
